hypothesis: v290 may have overfit because the attention residual was too flexible. A zero-initialized, strongly regularized linear runner-utility correction can test whether stable omitted linear effects remain in v283 while preserving the parent exactly at initialization.

features.numeric_missing_mask: one explicit mask per selected raw and course feature
features.normalization: training-races-only mean and standard deviation; missing standardized value zero

structure.runner_utility: one zero-initialized linear head per finishing position over standardized runner features, missing masks, and lane one-hot
structure.initialization: all head weights and biases exactly zero

training.d7: fit only on D6 chronological history and predict D7
training.d8: fit only on D6 plus D7 chronological history and predict D8

promotion_requires: mean delta versus v283 below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v283 child-family Holm-adjusted p below 0.05
difference_from_v290: v290 used a learned projection and self-attention. v292 has no nonlinear layers or attention and applies a strongly regularized linear correction only.
